categories.main_business_segments: Ningxia Baofeng Energy Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in coal-based chemical materials, including coal mining and washing, coking, methanol production, olefin production, fine chemicals, and new energy. The company focuses on coal-to-olefins (polyethylene, polypropylene, EVA), coking products (coke, coal tar), and fine chemical products derived from coal-based raw materials. It also engages in coal mining, coal washing, and sales, as well as related equipment manufacturing and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced coal-to-olefins technology, synthesizing methanol from coal and then converting methanol into olefins such as ethylene and propylene. It integrates modern coal chemical processes with green hydrogen coupling technology to produce olefins, representing a leading edge in clean coal chemical production. The company also uses advanced coking technology and fine chemical processing methods to produce high-value products like methyl tert-butyl ether, coal tar derivatives, and modified asphalt.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as agriculture, packaging, consumer goods, automotive, home appliances, pipeline manufacturing, healthcare, electrical and chemical fiber industries, military, and aerospace. The steel industry is a major downstream market for coke products. The company serves both domestic markets across China, especially in North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions, and has limited overseas sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters in Ningdong Energy Chemical Base, Yinchuan, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. It has significant operations in Inner Mongolia (Ordos), including a large coal-based olefin project. The company’s geographic coverage includes major Chinese regions such as North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest, with some overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Baofeng Energy operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the coal chemical industry supply chain. It controls coal mining and washing (upstream), coking and methanol production (midstream), and downstream coal-to-olefin chemical production and fine chemical processing. The company integrates the entire coal chemical production chain from raw coal extraction to high-end chemical products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation focusing on green, autonomous, high-end, and intelligent coal chemical technologies. It invests heavily in R&D to improve energy efficiency, reduce emissions, and develop new product grades. Key R&D directions include clean coal utilization, green hydrogen integration, advanced coal-to-olefin processes, and development of high-performance polyolefin products. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of coal-based chemical products including polyethylene, polypropylene, EVA, coke, methanol, and fine chemicals. The company operates a direct sales model with a growing proportion of direct sales to end customers. It also earns income from related services such as equipment maintenance and leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Baofeng Energy is a leading player in China's coal-to-olefin industry, holding approximately 23.8% of the national coal-based olefin production capacity. It is among the top coal chemical enterprises in China, with competitive advantages in cost, technology, and scale. Competitors include other major coal chemical producers and traditional oil-based olefin producers. The company is recognized for its low production costs and energy consumption compared to peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 33 billion, a 13.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 6.34 billion, up 12.16%. Total assets reached RMB 89.57 billion, growing 25.04% from the previous year. The company’s net asset value was RMB 43 billion, up 11.6%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profit, and asset scale, supported by capacity expansions and operational improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Baofeng Energy emphasizes its integrated coal chemical production chain, cost advantages from resource-rich locations, and advanced clean coal technologies including green hydrogen integration. Its products are differentiated by high quality, diverse grades, and environmental sustainability. The company’s large-scale, technologically advanced facilities enable it to offer competitive pricing and stable supply, positioning it as a reliable supplier of high-end coal-based chemical materials with a strong commitment to green and low-carbon development.
